I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread: I can't confirm the 16 August date. I couldn't find any Tamsin Cold Chain account files to check it against, so I haven't recorded it as the deadline. I asked Pree to let me know if the account owner or the signed order form confirms it, and I'll update it then.

I didn't change my saved note either. It says the Tamsin Greywater order form is due 26 July, per Ilse. A secondhand, unverified date shouldn't replace that, and it may not even be the same company. I also left the 26 July date out of the channel reply. I can't tell where that note came from, so it may not be something Pree could already see.
